stim_id.Description: Video index 1-28 (trigger value); equals video_index in the events.

source_title.Description: Source film (Chen et al. 2023, Supplementary Table S1; same string as trial_type).

source_database.Description: Clip database the clip was taken from (Table S1): DCEF, THU-EP, FilmStim or PED; n/a where none is given.

database_clip.Description: The clip of the source database that this clip corresponds to: listed where Table S1 names the database and that database has exactly one clip of the same film with the same duration in whole seconds (DCEF, PED), or where the database distributes its clip files and this clip's content was matched to one of them frame by frame (FilmStim: number / code, file name and SHA-256 of the file as distributed at sites.uclouvain.be/ipsp/FilmStim; n/a otherwise).

database_timecode.Description: In-out timecode (h:mm:ss) that the source database publishes for that clip. It refers to the database authors' copy of the film; PED notes that times differ between film versions. n/a where database_clip is n/a.

database_position.Description: Where the presented clip lies inside the FilmStim file named in database_clip, from a frame-by-frame comparison of the clip's content with the file (2026-10-08): start-end in seconds of the FilmStim file, 'the whole FilmStim file', or why no position is given. 'likely' = two independent anchors agree (shot changes at both ends, unique length, or file length = presented length); nothing here was checked against FACED's own clip files. n/a where database_clip is not a FilmStim clip.

targeted_emotion.Description: Targeted emotion (Table S1); n/a for neutral clips.

table_s1_duration_s.Description: Clip duration given in Table S1.

presented_duration_s.Description: Median over 123 participants of the video span in the events (video index + 101 onset to 102 offset).

rights.Description: Rights note: the clips are excerpts of third-party films and are not part of this dataset.
